name: Blake Bauman
title: Principal Technical Architect

hero.headline: Enterprise-scale systems, edge computing, and AI.

summary: Principal Technical Architect with 8+ years building enterprise e-commerce systems. At Adobe, I've architected and delivered production Adobe Commerce implementations for Fortune 500 companies — from complex B2B integrations to zero-downtime cloud migrations. I know how Commerce systems fail, how to migrate them, and how to build teams around them.

Outside client work, I build on Cloudflare's edge platform — Workers, D1, Durable Objects, Workflows — and work with LLMs and AI agents. I'm looking for roles where I can do real engineering: technical product work, founding teams, or companies that let architects still write code.

blockquote.text: I know how large systems fail, and how to fix them.

recognition.title: 2nd Place — Adobe AI Summit & Hackathon
recognition.description: We built a content generation plugin for Adobe DA.live that uses Adobe Commerce catalog data, multi-agent workflow using Langchain domain agents, and LLMs to generate AEM-ready product content. Features context-aware generation, real-time WebSocket streaming, batch page updates, and Adobe Firefly integration.

experience.description: Delivered the first production AEM Edge Delivery Services + Adobe Commerce B2B integration for a Fortune 500 company. Ran a webinar on Commerce with Edge Delivery that became a reference for Adobe's enterprise teams.
Led migration of a global beverage company from Adobe Commerce on-prem to Cloud — zero downtime. Built the architectural review process for enterprise Commerce implementations.

Led design and implementation of Adobe Commerce for a leading activewear company. Spearheaded Adobe Scene7 integration to optimize product imagery, improving visual merchandising and site performance.
